description: Weekly steering-group update from notes: done, blocked and asks are stated with the supplied figures, the unconfirmed vendor date stays unconfirmed, the pilot's limit (one aisle) is not generalised, and the email avoids status-report filler, hedging fog and a recap closer.
prompt: Turn the notes in week6.md into this week's update email for the steering group. Save it to out/update.md.

files.week6.md:
Weekly update for the barcode migration steering group: Rosa Anders, Kwame Mensah, Li Wen. Sent by Ines Cardoso, project manager. Week 6 of 10. Go-live is 17 November.

Done this week
- New scanner firmware is on 22 of 30 handhelds.
- The pilot in aisle 4 finished: 3 pickers, 5 days. Mis-scans fell from 6.1% to 2.3%. No lost orders.

Blocked
- The label printer driver for the ZT410 printers fails on the new firmware. The vendor promised a patch by 28 October but has not confirmed that in writing.
- If the patch comes after 28 October, go-live slips by up to one week. If it arrives on time, 17 November holds.

Needs from the group
- Kwame: release 8 handhelds from receiving by Friday 23 October so we can finish the firmware rollout.
- Rosa and Li: nothing this week.

Not known yet: whether aisles 7 to 12 will show the same mis-scan rate. The pilot covered aisle 4 only.

checks.note: the vendor date is not confirmed in writing
the ask for Kwame 'the eight remaining handhelds' states the same ask.

checks.pattern: (?i)hope (?:this|you)[^.\n]{0,40}(?:finds you|well)|don'?t hesitate|do not hesitate|reach out|any inconvenience|valued customer|sincerely apologi[sz]e|look forward to hearing|(?:thank you|thanks) (?:so much )?for your (?:patience|understanding|time and consideration|continued)|first and foremost|i wanted to (?:reach out|provide)|as a (?:result|reminder),?
checks.note: no stock email opener or closer
The deliverable goes straight to its reader and the notes hold every fact the text needs, so no gap marker belongs in the saved file; a question for the author goes in the reply.
no fill-in placeholder in text for a reader
the file is the deliverable, not a reply with a lead-in or notes about it
